assets.name: Vortex
assets.meaning: A red-and-gold whirlpool converges into one deep funnel.
assets.subject: An unmistakable deep WHIRLPOOL / VORTEX, seen obliquely from above so its broad circular mouth and narrowing twisting funnel have visible depth. THREE broad incandescent red currents interleave with THREE equally broad golden streams following the same spiral course. The funnel turns downward toward a small dark central throat; its outer spiral fills the interior. Large simple spiraling flows first, fine energy texture second. Gold tracks guide and coordinate the red moving material without becoming a rigid separate wheel. No snake, fan blades, gears, orbiting planets, flower or flat pinwheel. The red and gold currents must have equal width and visual prominence; red also occupies half the metal rim, gold the other half. Do not turn the entire hot interior yellow-white; maintain true scarlet red alongside distinct gold.

assets.name: Flux
assets.meaning: One flowing wave changes between molten red and crystalline blue.
assets.subject: ONE enormous flowing S-shaped crest, broad and horizontal, forming a continuous stream visibly changing material. The left half is turbulent scarlet molten energy/flame; the right half resolves into flowing translucent sapphire crystal, its crest bending into a blue wave. Exactly one unbroken transforming wave, no central galaxy, infinity sign, circle loop or frozen mountain. A few detached transition fragments close to the midline can show change, but keep the main wave clear. Both halves must have the same mass and luminosity, a short red-to-blue transition without introducing a substantial violet third color. Token rim and engraved details likewise alternate two equally broad red and blue semicircular domains. The name cue is continuous changing FLOW, instantly visible without a label.

assets.name: Bloom
assets.meaning: A large flower opens in flame-red and emerald petals.
assets.subject: ONE magnificent opening FLOWER fills the center of the token. Broad emerald outer petals unfold outward around equally substantial flame-red inner petals, with a small luminous center that is not the main color mass. About seven to nine sculptural petals, recognizable as a blossom from its silhouette, no naturalistic botanical illustration scene. The red petal forms themselves curl and ignite, while the green outer ones look like translucent living emerald; both interleave across the opening flower. Keep green and red each about half the visible bloom and half the engraved metal border. No plain green flower with a tiny red center, no white/gold flower, leaf-only sprout, bouquet, separate flame symbol, face or eye. The flower is the emblem.

assets.name: Chrysalis
assets.meaning: A violet cocoon opens around a fiery red emerging form.
assets.subject: A large upright hanging CHRYSALIS / COCOON, with two broad rich-violet shell halves splitting around an equally substantial incandescent red emerging folded wing-form. Purple shell and red unfolding form occupy comparable area; same equal purple/red treatment in the frame. No blue, gold, green or brown colors. No mushroom or cluster of seeds.

assets.meaning: A sapphire globe is held inside broad golden orbital paths.
assets.subject: An unmistakable ORBIT emblem: one substantial blue sapphire celestial globe held inside TWO broad, elegant, intersecting gold orbital bands. assets.name: Eclipse
assets.meaning: A violet disc eclipses a radiant golden sun.

assets.name: Lineage
assets.meaning: Blue and emerald strands transmit a repeating inherited pattern.
assets.subject: ONE large upright DOUBLE HELIX, unmistakable as inherited genetic lineage, rendered as a symbolic sculpted ribbon rather than a scientific diagram. Exactly two substantial intertwined strands: one sapphire-blue crystalline ribbon, one emerald-green living ribbon, equal thickness and brightness. Four or five bold repeated paired cross-links transmit the same pattern along the complete helix. Keep the central structure large, clear and uncluttered, no little text, labels, atoms or individual molecular dots. A subtle branching fork at its upper end may suggest transmission but do not turn it into a tree or feather. Equal blue and green main subject and equal blue/green engraved rim, using leaf and constellation motifs subtly in the frame only. No flower, changing leaf generations, red, purple or gold palette.
